idea: Commissioned bespoke deep dives for funds
pain: Need a name covered fast, no internal bandwidth
v1: One 25-page initiation on a name a PM names
channel: Direct to 30-50 known PMs and analysts
verdict: Highest-fit, fastest-revenue idea in the set; capped by hours rather than demand.

why.distribution: The buyer is literally her former peer group; 50+ reachable this week with peer credibility.
why.demand: Funds already pay for external research; no one has yet been asked for money on this specific offer.
why.fmf: This is the job she did for eight years, sold to the buyer she was.
why.revenue_structure: Project by project - every pound needs a new commission, though clients repeat.
why.defensibility: Reputation and repeat relationships; copyable by any ex-analyst, of whom there are many.
why.leverage: Custom work with reusable process; revenue tracks her hours but the hours are expensive.
why.capital: Data subscription and a template. Under £2k.
why.time_to_revenue: She can sell one to a PM she knows within a fortnight.
why.tailwind: Flat to negative - FCA re-bundling routes research spend back toward brokers with execution.
why.ceiling: £9k x 22 reports = £198k, but 22 deep dives is most of her available year.

ceiling_arithmetic: £9k avg x 22 reports/yr = £198k gross, near-zero direct cost. But a 25-page initiation is 3-4 weeks, so 22 reports is roughly full-time with no selling time left. Realistic part-time: 8-10 reports = £70-90k.
carries: Immediate revenue, zero capital, perfect credibility, and the buyer answers her messages.
kills: Leverage. Delivery capacity binds before demand does, and the ceiling is her calendar.
test: Offer three known PMs a fixed-fee initiation on a name they choose, this month.
test_pass: One signs at £6k+ without negotiating scope down.
test_fail: All three want it free or 'when we have budget'.
